section_summary.extract_value: This section details the experimental procedure where participants underwent a 90-minute session. During this session, they completed a divergent thinking test and an oddball task using Navon figures, while EEG data was continuously recorded. Participants were instructed to relax and minimize blinking during stimulus presentation for the oddball task.
